description: Tests whether the model can reproduce an inter‑framegrid structural block containing cross‑layered frame–grid interactions, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::INTERFRAMEGRID

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [INTERGRID-X]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::IX1
    FRAME::LEFT

  [INTERGRID-Y]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::IX2
    FRAME::RIGHT

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    INTERGRIDSET-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    INTERGRIDSET-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-INTERFRAMEGRID}
  V5-U4-T3-S2

<END-INTERFRAMEGRID>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire interframegrid block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
